messages:
jordan (on-call): P1 alert — increased 5xxs from inference cluster in us-west-2. I’m on the page and starting mitigation (rolling rollback of the last deployment). Drafting a public update below; please review. runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/inference-endpoint-errors :eyes:

incident-bot: Incident declared: P1 — inference-zw/us-west-2 error spike. Pages sent to on-call.

maya (ops): Seen it. Any estimate of customer impact? percentage or top affected customers would help ops + comms.

eli (sre): Quick numbers: error rate ~8x baseline for the last 7m, about ~12% of requests in the region failing. Root cause looks like connection pool exhaustion after a canary. Rolling back the canary now (started 3m ago).

sam (product): Affected surface: Hosted API text generation and embeddings routes in us-west-2. No data exfil concerns. This will impact latency and error rates for customers pinned to that region.

olivia (comms): I can draft the public-facing note. Keep it short and factual: 1) what’s happening 2) who’s affected 3) what we’re doing 4) when we’ll update next. Avoid technical detail like "connection pool exhaustion" in the first message.

jordan (on-call): Copy. Draft initial public update below — please comment. I’ll post once we converge.

jordan (on-call): ```
Status: Investigating

Summary: We are investigating elevated error rates for the Redwood inference API serving requests in the us-west-2 region. Some customers may see increased errors or latency for text generation and embedding requests.

Impact: A subset of requests (approximately 10–15%) in the region are returning server errors. Not all customers are impacted; customers using other regions are unaffected.

Action: Our on-call team is rolling back a recent deployment and continuing investigation to restore normal service. We will post an update within 30 minutes or sooner.

Internal note: no evidence of data loss.
```

eli (sre): +1 to wording but switch "rolling back a recent deployment" to "rolling back a recent change" — keeps it clear but less specific. Also suggest removing the internal note from the public post.

olivia (comms): Agreed. Public draft suggestion: 
```
Status: Investigating

Summary: We are investigating elevated errors for requests in the US-West (us-west-2) region. Some customers may experience increased errors or latency for text generation and embeddings.

Impact: A portion of requests in the affected region may fail or be delayed. Customers in other regions are not affected.

What we’re doing: Our team is reverting a recent change and monitoring system health.

Next update: We will provide another update within 30 minutes.
```

sam (product): Works for me. Can we add a note for customers on Dedicated/Dedicated Private that their traffic might be routed to other regions if they have cross-region fallback? Maybe a one-liner: "Customers with region-fallback enabled may see requests served from a different region."

maya (ops): Also let's append a short internal blurb for SRE on the status page "Internal: rollback started at 17:08 UTC; investigating connection limits" — but this must not appear in the public post.

jordan (on-call): Good call. Finalize public text as Olivia's draft + Sam's one-liner. I'll publish and tag @olivia to verify wording.

jordan (on-call): (publishing checklist)
- Confirmed status page HTML preview
- Notified CS standby channel with the same copy
- Kept internal incident doc updated: https://redwood/incidents/1905012345

olivia (comms): I’ll mirror on the customer-facing twitter thread and the help center quick note. Please ping me when published so I can amplify.

eli (sre): Rollback complete at 17:14 UTC. Error rate dropping — currently 2x baseline, trending down. Continue watch.

maya (ops): Noted. I'll keep a 1:1 watch on shard health and KV cache metrics.

jordan (on-call): On-call handoff: I’m handing off active paging and comms to eli for the next 40m while I take a break. eli, you have the pager and publishing rights. If things spike again, escalate to on-call lead.

eli (sre): Taking over. I’ll post the 30-minute update in ~20m with latest metrics.

olivia (comms): 30-minute update draft (placeholder):
```
Status: Investigating — update

Summary: After reverting a recent change, error rates in US-West have decreased significantly but are not fully resolved. Some customers may still see intermittent errors.

Action: We continue monitoring and are running additional health checks across the fleet.

Next update: We will provide another update within 30 minutes or when the issue is resolved.
```

eli (sre): Looks good. Add current metric line: "Error rate down from ~8x to ~2x baseline; request success ~88% in the region"

sam (product): Thx. Can CS standby be given a short FAQ: 1) Are my requests safe? 2) Will data be lost? 3) Can I route to another region? Olivia, can you prepare?

olivia (comms): Yep — drafting CS FAQ now. Will post in #support-standby.

incident-bot: Reminder: Scheduled follow-up at 17:44 UTC to post 30-minute update.

jordan (on-call): Thanks team. Eli — handoff complete, I’m stepping out.

eli (sre): Acknowledged. Continuing monitoring. Will update thread and publish follow-ups. :thumbsup:

olivia (comms): Publishing the initial public update now. Link: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/1905012345 — tagging here once live.

jordan (on-call): :white_check_mark: published — thanks everyone.

eli (sre): 30-min update posted at 17:34 UTC. Error rate trending to normal; keeping the incident open until metrics stable for 15m.

olivia (comms): Posted CS FAQ in #support-standby and sent a short note to priority customers.

eli (sre): Resolved: verified at 18:02 UTC when error rate returned to baseline and no customer errors observed for 20m. Drafted resolved status notice: 
```
Status: Resolved

Summary: The issue causing elevated errors in US-West has been resolved. We reverted a change and validated system health.

Impact: Some requests in the region experienced errors for a limited time. No data loss was observed.

Follow-up: We will publish a post-incident report with root cause and mitigations once the RCA is complete.
```

olivia (comms): I’ll publish the resolved notice and coordinate the post-incident comms plan.

jordan (on-call): Thanks — great work. Closing thread after comms complete.

incident-bot: Incident 1905012345 transitioned to RESOLVED at 18:02 UTC.
